messages.plaintextBody:
OpenWeatherMap API Instruction

Dear Customer!

Thank you for subscribing to Free OpenWeatherMap!

API key:
- Within the next couple of hours, your API key 8b8bdabb5562a060c506500ea8a3d5d7 will be activated and ready to use
- You can later create more API keys on your account page
- Please, always use your API key in each API call

Endpoint:
- Please, use the endpoint api.openweathermap.org for your API calls

Example of API call:
api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=London,uk&APPID=8b8bdabb5562a060c506500ea8a3d5d7

Useful links:
- API documentation https://openweathermap.org/api
- Details of your plan https://openweathermap.org/price
- Please, note that 16-days daily forecast and History API are not available for Free subscribers

Best Regards,
OpenWeather team

Copyright © 2026 OpenWeather Ltd., All rights reserved.
You are receiving this email because you are a user of OpenWeather services.
